faq.sub: Everything agencies ask before they sell their first Coworker. If yours is not in there, the founders are right below.

what.question: What is the Rerun white label?
what.answer: A plug-and-play version of Rerun under your brand: your URL, your colors, your logo, and a mobile app in your name. You hand it to your clients and manage them all from one place.

who.question: Who is it for?
who.answer: Agencies, consultants and freelancers who want to sell AI Coworkers to their clients as a service: prospecting, support, social media, invoicing or recruiting.

custom.question: How is it different from building custom agents?
custom.answer: With Hermes or custom code, every new client means starting over, then hosting and fixing what you built. Here you build a Coworker once, drop it into any client, and Rerun runs it for you.

start.question: How do I get started?
start.answer: Book a call with the founders. We look at your clients and the Coworkers you want to sell, then set up your brand with you.

brand.question: Can I use my own domain, colors and logo?
brand.answer: Yes. Your clients open the app on an address of yours, such as app.youragency.com, in your colors and with your logo. They never see Rerun.

reuse.question: Can I reuse a Coworker across clients?
reuse.answer: Yes. Build it once with its skills and its apps, keep it in your library, then drag and drop it into the workspace of any client.

mobile.question: Do my clients get a mobile app?
mobile.answer: Yes. They follow their Coworkers and answer them from a mobile app in your name and with your logo.

manage.question: Can I manage all my clients from one place?
manage.answer: Yes. Each client has its own workspace, with its own Coworkers, memory, files and apps, and you move from one to the next from a single account.

team.question: Can my clients invite their team?
team.answer: Yes, as many teammates as they want, at no extra cost. Anyone on their team can answer a Coworker that is waiting.

bill.question: How do I bill my clients?
bill.answer: You set your own price and bill your clients yourself. Rerun bills you, never them.

cost.question: How much does the white label cost?
cost.answer: It depends on how many clients you run on it. Book a call with the founders and we will give you a price.

ai.question: Who pays for the AI?
ai.answer: Each workspace runs on the AI you choose for it: the client's ChatGPT or Claude plan, your own API keys, or the Rerun credits included.

pricing.title: Priced per client workspace.
pricing.lead: The more clients you run on it, the less each one costs. Pick your count, then book a short call to get started.
pricing.costAnswer: A price per client workspace and per month that goes down with each client you add, from {min} workspaces: {tiers}. Every workspace pays the price of the count you reach.
